To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a novel key-establishment scheme is proposed for distributed sensor networks.
we propose a multivariate key pre-distri-bution scheme for distributed sensor networks that provides many nice features without any disadvantages.

we propose a novel threshold key pre-distribution technique that is suitable for large-scale sensor networks, which is secure up to the compromise of a certain fraction (up to 90% in some cases) of sensor nodes, and is scalable, i.e., the designer can adjust the security and network connectivity properties according to the application.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of a secure and efficient key establishment scheme for distributed sensor networks.
the design of a key pre-distribution protocol for sensor networks that provides the best security and network connectivity properties.
the design of an efficient and robust multivariate key pre-deployment scheme for distributed sensor networks.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed MKPS provides many nice features without any disadvantages.
our scheme has the best security and network connectivity among previous schemes.
MKPS is an efficient and secure key establishment scheme for distributed sensor networks that can be deployed in various applications.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have proposed an n-dimensional threshold key establishment scheme that provides a number of nice features without any disadvantages.
we have proposed a novel threshold key establishment method in distributed sensor networks that is based on multivariate polynomials and provides a number of attractive properties.

we have proposed a new key pre-distribution method for distributed sensor networks that simultaneously provides many features of previous schemes, such as perfect security, network scalability, and node-to-node authentication.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a multivariate scheme can provide a more secure and flexible key pre-distribution in distributed sensor networks.
a simple multivariate key pre-distri-bution scheme is sufficient to address many of the challenges in key establishment of sensor networks.
the security level and the network properties are two sides of the same coin.
